---
applyTo: "labs/**/*.md,specs/**/*.md,facilitator/**/*.md"
---

# Workshop documentation and specifications

- Write for a participant who can follow the repository but cannot see the
  authoring chat. Use numbered actions, exact working directories, copyable
  commands, observable checkpoints, and explicit completion criteria.
- Keep Java and .NET as equivalent alternatives when both tracks apply. Do not
  make completion of one depend on the other.
- Specifications must distinguish requirements, constraints, acceptance
  criteria, allowed paths, exclusions, validation, and stop conditions.
- Label starter material and facilitator-only reference solutions clearly.
  Do not reveal facilitator solutions from participant steps unless the lab
  explicitly tells facilitators when to use them.
- Use repository-relative Markdown links and verify every local target. Do not
  claim a command passed without recorded evidence.
- Use placeholders only in clearly marked templates. Finished examples and
  reference solutions must not contain unresolved `TODO`, `TBD`, or template
  tokens.
